_note: Hand-curated list of notable enacted AI laws. Verified via web research on 2026-09-30. Not exhaustive — update by hand when new laws pass. Brazil's PL 2338/2023 is deliberately EXCLUDED: it passed the Senate in Dec 2024 but is still pending in the Chamber of Deputies, not law.

laws.name: Artificial Intelligence Act — Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
laws.summary: The world's first comprehensive AI law: risk-tiered rules (prohibited / high-risk / transparency duties), conformity assessments for high-risk systems, and obligations for general-purpose AI models. Phased application through 2027–2028.

laws.name: Interim Measures for the Management of Generative AI Services
laws.summary: Requires generative AI services offered to the Chinese public to align with socialist values, complete security assessments and algorithm filings before launch, and respect IP and personal-information protections. Issued jointly by the CAC and six other regulators.

laws.name: AI Basic Act (Framework Act on AI Development and Establishment of Trust)
laws.summary: Consolidated 19 prior bills into Asia's first comprehensive AI framework. Risk-based duties for 'high-impact' AI (impact assessments, human oversight), generative-output labeling, and extraterritorial reach; fines up to KRW 30 million.

laws.name: AI Promotion Act (Act No. 53 of 2025)
laws.summary: Japan's first AI-specific national law. Innovation-first: no fines or penalties — the government may issue guidance, request information, or publicly name non-compliant entities. Established an AI Strategy Headquarters.

laws.name: Texas Responsible AI Governance Act (TRAIGA), HB 149
laws.summary: Comprehensive state AI statute: prohibits AI used to manipulate behavior, enable unlawful discrimination, or generate CSAM; bans government social scoring; creates a 36-month regulatory sandbox and AI advisory council. Enforced exclusively by the Texas AG.

laws.name: Connecticut AI Responsibility and Transparency (CART) Act, SB 5
laws.summary: Omnibus state AI law: anti-discrimination rules for automated employment decision tools, deployer disclosure duties, AI subscription and chatbot provisions, and whistleblower protections for frontier-AI developers. Notice requirements phase in through 2028.
